p: Genius inventor in powered armor who helped found the Avengers.
The super-soldier and moral compass. The shield is now carried by Sam.
God of Thunder wielding Stormbreaker, now roaming the cosmos.
Scientist and green powerhouse, now merged into “Smart Hulk.”
The wall-crawler whose identity the whole world has forgotten.
Master of the Mystic Arts and guardian of reality's barriers.
Reality-warping chaos magic. Seemingly died at Mount Wundagore. Her status changed in VisionQuest's post-credits scene (see News).
A cosmic powerhouse and one of the strongest heroes alive.
Wakanda's protector. The mantle is now carried by Shuri.
Shrinks and grows with Pym Particles, and unlocked the time heist.
Master martial artist who wields the Ten Rings.
Trickster turned timekeeper who now holds the timelines together.
Ex-Red Room spy and founding Avenger. Gave her life on Vormir for the Soul Stone.
Master archer and founding Avenger, now mentoring Kate Bishop.
A synthezoid born from the Mind Stone. Rebuilt as “White Vision” in WandaVision, then given a full arc in VisionQuest (2026) alongside his sons Tommy and Billy.
Leader of the Guardians until Vol. 3, when he handed the team to Rocket and went home to Earth.
A teenage hero with cosmic light powers, now recruiting the next generation.
Natasha's sister and leader of the New Avengers. Florence Pugh says she plays a big part in Doomsday.
The Earth-10005 pair who saved their universe from the TVA in Deadpool & Wolverine (2024).
